name: AllowPolicy
description: Maintains an allowlist. Rejects the transaction if any checked address is not on the list.

configFields.name: allowlist
configFields.description: Addresses permitted to participate in transactions protected by this policy.

name: BypassPolicy
description: Maintains an allowlist. If all checked addresses are on the list, immediately allows the transaction and skips all remaining policies.

configFields.name: bypassList
configFields.description: Addresses permitted to bypass all remaining policy checks.

name: RejectPolicy
description: Maintains a denylist. Rejects the transaction if any checked address is on the list.

configFields.name: rejectList
configFields.description: Addresses blocked from participating in transactions protected by this policy.

name: OnlyAuthorizedSenderPolicy
description: Rejects the transaction if the sender (msg.sender) is not on the authorized list.

configFields.name: authorizedList
configFields.description: If the sender is not on this list, method calls will be rejected.

name: MaxPolicy
description: Rejects the transaction if the extracted value exceeds a configured maximum.

configFields.name: max
configFields.description: Maximum amount.

name: PausePolicy
description: Global toggle. Rejects every transaction when paused; passes through when unpaused.

configFields.name: paused
configFields.description: The paused state.

name: IntervalPolicy
description: Divides time into repeating slot-based cycles. Rejects if the current slot is outside the allowed window.

configFields.name: startSlot
configFields.description: The lowest (inclusive) slot index within the cycle for which execution is allowed.

configFields.name: endSlot
configFields.description: The highest (exclusive) slot index within the cycle for which execution is allowed.

configFields.name: cycleParameters
configFields.description: Cycle parameters: slotDuration (seconds per slot), cycleSize (total slots per cycle), cycleOffset (slot offset).

name: VolumeRatePolicy
description: Tracks cumulative volume per account per time period. Rejects if the period's cap would be exceeded.

configFields.name: maxAmount
configFields.description: The maximum allowed transfer amount within a single time period.

configFields.name: timePeriodDuration
configFields.description: The duration (in seconds) of the time period for tracking transfers.

name: CredentialRegistryIdentityValidatorPolicy
description: Checks each address against configured credential requirements. Rejects if any address lacks required credentials.

configFields.name: credentialSources
configFields.type: array of { credentialTypeId, identityRegistry, credentialRegistry, dataValidator }
configFields.description: List of credential sources per credential type.

configFields.name: credentialRequirements
configFields.type: array of { requirementId, credentialTypeIds, minValidations, invert }
configFields.description: List of credential requirements to validate an identity.

name: CertifiedActionDONValidatorPolicy
description: Validates DON-issued permits delivered on-chain via the Keystone Forwarder. Rejects if no valid permit exists.

configFields.name: keystoneForwarder
configFields.description: Trusted Keystone Forwarder address allowed to call onReport() and issue DON-based permits.

configFields.name: issuers
configFields.description: Workflow owners authorized to issue certified action permits.

name: RoleBasedAccessControlPolicy
description: Maps roles to function selectors. Rejects if the sender does not hold a role allowed for the called function.

configFields.name: roleAssignments
configFields.description: List of role assignments (role + account) for grantRole/revokeRole operations.

configFields.name: roleOperationAllowances
configFields.description: List of roles mapped to operations (function signatures).

name: VolumePolicy
description: Rejects the transaction if the extracted value is below a minimum or above a maximum.

configFields.name: minAmount
configFields.description: The minimum volume amount. If set to 0, there is no minimum limit.

configFields.name: maxAmount
configFields.description: The maximum volume amount. If set to 0, there is no maximum limit.

name: SecureMintPolicy
description: Checks a Chainlink Proof of Reserve feed. Rejects if minting would push total supply beyond verified reserves.

configFields.name: reservesFeed
configFields.description: Chainlink AggregatorV3 price feed contract address used as reserves source.

configFields.name: tokenMetadata
configFields.description: Token metadata including address and decimals.

configFields.name: reserveMarginConfigs
configFields.description: Reserve margin configuration. Mode: 0=None, 1=PositivePercentage, 2=PositiveAbsolute, 3=NegativePercentage, 4=NegativeAbsolute.

configFields.name: maxStalenessSeconds
configFields.description: Maximum age (in seconds) of the reserve data feed before the policy rejects. 0 disables the check.
